pages.text: Greetings, young warrior. I am Lionheart. Hunting begins with patience. Crouch low, keep your tail still, and creep forward. Prey feels your pawsteps before it sees you.
pages.title: Stalking

pages.text: Mice hide in grass and herbs. They are the easiest prey to catch, perfect for a new hunter.
Squirrels stay near logs and are very fast. Do not scare one, or you will be chasing it up a tree!
Pigeons react quickly and often fly off. Catching them takes practice. $(br2)Lizards are training prey for kits and apprentices. Chase them for fun, but do not count on them to feed the Clan.
pages.title: Pigeons and Lizards
